# Deviload 2.16.0

**Sound moods, lyric videos, a map of your taste and lights that follow the music.** Devil Music can play a song slowed with reverb, as Nightcore or in 8D, turn a few sung lines into a video for stories, draw the artists you listen to as a star chart, and light your keyboard, mouse and strips in the cover's colour on every beat.

- Sound moods sit in More on the player bar: Slowed + reverb, Nightcore and 8D. A badge on the bar shows the mood that plays and turns it off in one click.
- Share a line has a Video switch: a vertical video of up to 30 seconds with the song's own sound, the words filling in as they are sung and a waveform that is also the progress. It is saved as MP4, ready for stories, Reels and Shorts.
- Statistics have a Map tab: the artists you listen to as a star chart, with their covers, constellations of artists you play together, a card on hover and the artist a click away.
- RGB lighting that follows the music: through OpenRGB, your keyboard, mouse, strips, memory and graphics card take the cover's colour and pulse with the bass, and get their own effects back when you turn it off.
- New features are shown once: a dot on the button that leads to them and a single tip the first time you open it.

### Devil Music

The queue saves as a playlist, shuffles the songs still to come once and clears down to the current song with an undo. An optional notification names each new song while Deviload is in the tray or behind another window, and the tray tooltip names the song playing. Lyrics can be searched and played from the line found, and their source can be chosen per song: automatic, LRCLIB, Better Lyrics or Unison. Lists sort newest first or longest first.

The close button hides Deviload to the tray, unless you turn it off, and the tray menu opens the mini player. The mini player is back on the player bar with its own icon and opens with I. Casting to a TV or speaker stops in one click from the bar or More. The host of a listening room sees how many are listening and closes the room from the bar.

The home keeps its quick tiles in two rows and the moods on one sliding line. An artist page shows similar artists right after the artist's music, with Follow and Following, Save and Saved. Empty pages show their own icons and the last rows stay clear of the player bar.

### Fixes

The mini player can be opened again on wide windows. A guest whose host closed the listening room leaves it by themselves and their own music plays again. Right-click and browser keys such as F5 and Ctrl+P no longer bring up the web view's menu or reload the app.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
